_meta.about: Independent reference values for the app's galaxies and galaxy groups (scripts/crosscheck/galaxies.py).
_meta.d: light-years; geometric mean of the reference distances of the best tier (primary = Cepheid/TRGB/SBF/maser from Cosmicflows-4 and NED-D; secondary = all redshift-independent methods; redshift = HyperLEDA modz / Hickson z, H0=70)
_meta.size: D25 isophotal diameter [major, minor] arcmin (HyperLEDA logd25, logr25; Hickson group size for HCGs); size_rc3 = RC3 D25 major axis; w = size[0] x d in light-years
_meta.mag: total magnitude in the band the app uses (V: RC3 BT-(B-V)T or HyperLEDA vt; B: HyperLEDA bt)
_meta.mass: published total (halo) mass, Msun, only where well measured; mdyn25 = vmax^2 R25 / G, a lower bound for the total
_meta.mstar: stellar mass, Msun (published, or estimated from HyperLEDA btc and (B-V) with Bell & de Jong 2001 M/L)
